disclaimer: Regulatory permissions under FSSAI are strictly category-specific according to the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011. The presence of an INS number does NOT indicate blanket permission across all food categories. Status is 'unverified' where category-specific authorization has not been audited.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - Appendix A (GMP in specified foods)
WHO / FAO JECFA Toxicological Evaluation of Certain Food Additives - Monosodium L-glutamate

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) in specified categories under FSSAI regulations; prohibited in foods intended for infants below 12 months. Mandatory advisory required: 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR INFANTS BELOW 12 MONTHS'.
additives.scope_limitations: Permission is restricted to specific food categories; not permitted in milk, infant formula, or unflavored staples.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - Table 2 (Artificial Sweeteners)
WHO IARC & JECFA Joint Assessment of Aspartame (2023)

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted only in specified food categories subject to quantitative maximum limits (e.g. carbonated water max 700 ppm, chewing gum max 10,000 ppm). Mandatory label warnings required: 'CONTAINS ARTIFICIAL SWEETENER' and 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR PHENYLKETONURICS'.
additives.scope_limitations: Prohibited in general foods outside explicitly authorized product categories.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - Food Colours

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted in specified foods (including carbonated beverages, confectionery) subject to statutory limits and purity specifications (including 4-MEI threshold).
additives.scope_limitations: Prohibited in fresh meat, fruit, tea, coffee, and unflavoured dairy.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) in various food formulations; must declare botanical source if derived from major allergens (e.g. Soya).
additives.scope_limitations: General food usage subject to GMP standards.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - Class II Preservatives Schedule

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted Class II chemical preservative with strict statutory numerical limits by food category (e.g., fruit juices/squashes max 600 ppm, carbonated fruit beverages max 120 ppm).
additives.scope_limitations: Strict category-specific maximum residue limits apply; prohibited in foods where chemical preservation is disallowed.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) in most processed food categories unless prohibited by a specific commodity standard.
additives.scope_limitations: GMP usage across broad food categories.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - Synthetic Food Colours Schedule

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted synthetic food colour strictly limited to authorized categories (e.g. biscuits, confectionery, fruit syrups) with mandatory upper limits (max 100 ppm; max 200 ppm in canned fruit). Prohibited in dairy, meat, tea, spices. Requires mandatory label disclosure: 'CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR(S)'.
additives.scope_limitations: Strict category list; prohibited in unprocessed staples and dairy products.

sources.title: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

additives.regulatory_status: Permitted under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) in bakery products, snack foods, and cereal flours.
additives.scope_limitations: Authorized for GMP usage in specified product categories.
